title: Māyāpañcakam
subtitle: Five verses on the power of māyā

source.edition: The Works of Sri Sankaracharya, vol. 16, Sri Vani Vilas Press, 1910
source.digitalText: Ambuda CC0 1.0; machine-readable text credit: Arun Prasad

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
निरुपमनित्यनिरंशकेऽप्यखण्डे मयि चिति सर्वविकल्पनादिशून्ये ।
घटयति जगदीशजीवभेदं त्वघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: Within me, consciousness—unmatched, eternal, partless, undivided, and free of every conceptual distinction—māyā brings about a difference between the Lord of the universe and the individual soul. She is indeed skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: free of all conceptual distinctions and the like
a difference between the Lord of the universe and the individual soul
skilled at making the impossible happen

units.iast:
nirupamanityaniraṃśake’pyakhaṇḍe mayi citi sarvavikalpanādiśūnye |
ghaṭayati jagadīśajīvabhedaṃ tvaghaṭitaghaṭanāpaṭīyasī māyā ||

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
श्रुतिशतनिगमान्तशोधकानप्यहह धनादिनिदर्शनेन सद्यः ।
कलुषयति चतुष्पदाद्यभिन्नानघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: Alas, by lures such as wealth, māyā quickly corrupts even those who study hundreds of revealed texts and the Upaniṣads, making them no different from quadrupeds and the like. She is skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: the end of the Vedas, the Upaniṣads
by examples or lures such as wealth
skilled at making the impossible happen

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
सुखचिदखण्डविबोधमद्वितीयं वियदनलादिविनिर्मिते नियोज्य ।
भ्रमयति भवसागरे नितान्तं त्वघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: Having placed undivided awareness-bliss, non-dual consciousness, in a world fashioned from space, fire, and the rest, māyā utterly leads it astray in the ocean of becoming. She is indeed skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: skilled at making the impossible happen

units.iast:
sukhacidakhaṇḍavibodhamadvitīyaṃ viyadanalādivinirmite niyojya |
bhramayati bhavasāgare nitāntaṃ tvaghaṭitaghaṭanāpaṭīyasī māyā ||

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
अपगतगुणवर्णजातिभेदे सुखचिति विप्रविडाद्यहंकृतिं च ।
स्फुटयति सुतदारगेहमोहं त्वघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: In blissful consciousness, beyond distinctions of qualities, social class, and birth, māyā makes the ego-sense “I am a Brahmin, a merchant, and so on” plainly appear; she also produces attachment to children, spouse, and home. She is indeed skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: qualities • social class • distinctions of birth
skilled at making the impossible happen

units.iast:
apagataguṇavarṇajātibhede sukhaciti vipraviḍādyahaṃkṛtiṃ ca |
sphuṭayati sutadāragehamohaṃ tvaghaṭitaghaṭanāpaṭīyasī māyā ||

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
विधिहरिहरविभेदमप्यखण्डे बत विरचय्य बुधानपि प्रकामम् ।
भ्रमयति हरिहरभेदभावानघटितघटनापटीयसी माया ॥
units.translation: Alas, māyā creates even a distinction among Brahmā, Hari, and Hara within the undivided reality, thoroughly confusing even the wise with the belief that Hari and Hara are different. She is skilled at making the impossible happen.

gloss.en: the belief that Hari and Hara are different
skilled at making the impossible happen

units.iast:
vidhihariharavibhedamapyakhaṇḍe bata viracayya budhānapi prakāmam |
bhramayati hariharabhedabhāvānaghaṭitaghaṭanāpaṭīyasī māyā ||

units.label: Closing colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ मायापञ्चकं संपूर्णम् ॥
units.translation: Thus the Māyāpañcakam is complete: it was composed by the revered Śaṅkara Bhagavat, supreme renunciant and teacher among wandering ascetics, disciple of the worship-worthy feet of Govinda Bhagavat.

gloss.en: of the teacher among wandering ascetics
whose feet are worthy of worship

units.iast: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau māyāpañcakaṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
